title: Normalize the zero-retention QQ16 decoder with paid rank-one children
head: efa51a6c7ffec6edd556a98deedfe9deeba65809
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

PR2681's zero-retention QQ16 decoder uses 112 rank-one and 448 rank-eight children. This implements the **same complete logical decoder with 336 positive rank-one children and no rank-eight children**. At each actual stage-2 port, a source-derived affine map takes F17 to `F16 C_q`; paid signed line normalizations enter the common F16 query frame and restore F17 afterward. The new 3,823-event word returns all 224 original arrays in F17, leaves all 224 current borrowed fields untouched, uses 224 owned output banks and at most sixteen owned scratch arrays, and retains no early values across B1.

The exact local invoice is 336 H1 children, 672 monomial wrappers, 464 full-cover maps and 25,840 real scalar primitives. Against PR2540's retained-record decoder, the child-moment numerator is `112 - 16*8^(1-a)`, strictly negative for `0 <= a <= 1/16`, proved using `8^15 > 7^16`. This changes the predecessor's child-cost comparison. The extra 192 wrappers, 256 maps and 8,368 scalar allowance remain liabilities: physical hosting, movement, rounded precision and the output consumer are unresolved. This is a finite local construction with an exact phase proof, not a full supplier, optimum or new kappa.

## Task and overlap

The fixed `portable-replay` picker was preserved; TASK records a changed scope after bounded engineering screens found adjacent acceptance audits covered. The concrete new result is the physical frame lowering of [PR2681](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2681) at `ea96706295631be10d92ae149b63c3e24acaeabc`; its logical inverse, scalar word and source reconstruction are credited and retained. [The advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2681#issuecomment-6198194973) records the bounded question and stopping condition.

Construction base: canonical main `1884c509efc004524786e9b7cfcc4aca572316d5`, priority revision 5. Precommit canonical main refreshed to `b5ea56e0a5ac4552166253b1fa4be0753bb38c30`; all five scientific inputs, three provenance inputs, guidance and runner/baseline scripts remain byte-identical. The frozen scientific base and pins are intentionally retained. Overlap combines the dated complete 817-PR/1,279-Discussion snapshot with the newest 100 open PRs and exact source head/comments; it is bounded coverage, not a universal novelty claim.

[PR2651](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2651) coalesces banks while retaining sixteen early values. [PR2678](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2678) separately prices adapters from the F17 endpoint. [PR2692](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2692) and [PR2628](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2628) address errors in the different PR2540 word; their bounds are not transferred here.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -O -B research/qq16-line-normalized-decoder/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/qq16-line-normalized-decoder
```

Native Windows CPython 3.12.7 registered replay passes the full primary and four export/integrity groups. Evidence covers both 224-array inverse orders, the intermediate B1 boundary, arbitrary owned dirt, every physical frame/ownership event, 1,210,496 literal character identities, all 114,688 signed native basis columns and all 336 child occurrences. Eleven semantic controls reject missing/wrong normalization, phase shifts, restoration, borrowed writes, dirt, scratch leaks and native wrapper defects. Source bytes are authenticated before execution; Git-free read-only export, complete pin inventory, typed-receipt rejection and exclusive regeneration pass.

A separate OpenAI Codex agent imported no candidate executable: it independently derived all 224 affine shifts from the selected archive/registry, walked all 3,823 physical events, compared the complete logical-event projection with the retained source, and checked the signed kernels and invoice. Its native CPython 3.14.5 optimized primary also passes. The written character proof explicitly extends through every owner coordinate and every payload tensor factor. No hosted CI, selected cold replay, formal-kernel or independent human review is claimed.

Exact predecessor bytes, attribution and notices are retained. New work by ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in derivation, implementation, writing and separate-agent review. Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

The package README records two concrete next obligations: identify a caller with a favorable complete map/wrapper/hosting invoice, and bind precision to this actual changed word. Neither is supplied by the child-moment improvement. Stop at this local module until those contracts are pinned.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
